n, k = map(int, input().split())
p = list(map(float, input().split()))

count_positive = sum(1 for prob in p if prob > 1e-6)

if count_positive <= k:
    result = ['1' if prob > 1e-6 else '0' for prob in p]
    print(' '.join(result))
    exit()

ans = [0.0] * n
dp = [0.0] * (1 << n)
dp[0] = 1.0

for mask in range(1 << n):
    sum_prob = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            sum_prob += p[i]
    if sum_prob >= 0.99999:
        continue
    for i in range(n):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            continue
        next_mask = mask | (1 << i)
        dp[next_mask] += dp[mask] * p[i] / (1 - sum_prob)

for mask in range(1 << n):
    cnt = bin(mask).count('1')
    if cnt != k:
        continue
    for i in range(n):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            ans[i] += dp[mask]

print(' '.join(f"{val:.13f}" for val in ans))
